sources.title: H3 Eros Max | beta6 | PromptHero
sources.snippet: Everything was done differently and from scratch on the release full bf16 fl2va model as a base. Reference timestep, viggle deltas, turbo deltas, and Lora mix were integrated and then pruned. The Lora mix uses a unique application with a shared strength cap and a contribution 'noise floor'.
